name: Workshop Wrecker

summary: Once a day, a whirlwind of tools batters everyone else in the room for a minute; the smaller the room, the harder it hits.
text: Once per dawn, as a Magic action, you set this device spinning for 1 minute. As it starts, and at the start of each of your turns, each other creature in the room makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking Bludgeoning damage on a failure: DC 18 and 6d6 + 5 in a space up to a 15-foot cube, DC 17 and 4d6 + 4 up to 30 feet, DC 15 and 2d6 + 2 up to 50 feet, DC 14 and 1d6 + 1 up to 100 feet. A bigger room takes no real harm, and outdoors the whirlwind flies off at 300 feet a round. You can stop it with a word (no action) from within 30 feet. It also smashes unattended ordinary objects. (In a fight the room is the map.)

powers.name: Wreck
powers.text: Once a day: a minute of flying tools, everyone else in the room saves or is battered.
